name: inspector2
description: Amazon Inspector is a vulnerability discovery service that automates continuous scanning for security vulnerabilities within your Amazon EC2, Amazon ECR, and Amazon Web Services Lambda environments.

subcommands.name: associate-member
subcommands.description: Associates an Amazon Web Services account with an Amazon Inspector delegated administrator.

subcommands.name: batch-associate-code-security-scan-configuration
subcommands.description: Associates multiple code repositories with an Amazon Inspector code security scan configuration.

subcommands.name: batch-disassociate-code-security-scan-configuration
subcommands.description: Disassociates multiple code repositories from an Amazon Inspector code security scan configuration.

subcommands.name: batch-get-account-status
subcommands.description: Retrieves the Amazon Inspector status of multiple Amazon Web Services accounts within your environment.

subcommands.name: batch-get-code-snippet
subcommands.description: Retrieves code snippets from findings that Amazon Inspector detected code vulnerabilities in.

subcommands.name: batch-get-finding-details
subcommands.description: Gets vulnerability details for findings.

subcommands.name: batch-get-free-trial-info
subcommands.description: Gets free trial status for multiple Amazon Web Services accounts.

subcommands.name: batch-get-member-ec2-deep-inspection-status
subcommands.description: Retrieves Amazon Inspector deep inspection activation status of multiple member accounts within your organization.

subcommands.name: batch-update-member-ec2-deep-inspection-status
subcommands.description: Activates or deactivates Amazon Inspector deep inspection for the provided member accounts in your organization.

subcommands.name: cancel-findings-report
subcommands.description: Cancels the given findings report.

subcommands.name: cancel-sbom-export
subcommands.description: Cancels a software bill of materials (SBOM) report.

subcommands.name: create-cis-scan-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a CIS scan configuration.

subcommands.name: create-code-security-integration
subcommands.description: Creates a code security integration with a source code repository provider.

subcommands.name: create-code-security-scan-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a scan configuration for code security scanning.

subcommands.name: create-connector
subcommands.description: Creates a connector that links an external cloud provider to Amazon Inspector for vulnerability scanning.

subcommands.name: create-filter
subcommands.description: Creates a filter resource using specified filter criteria.

subcommands.name: create-findings-report
subcommands.description: Creates a finding report.

subcommands.name: create-sbom-export
subcommands.description: Creates a software bill of materials (SBOM) report.

subcommands.name: delete-cis-scan-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes a CIS scan configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-code-security-integration
subcommands.description: Deletes a code security integration.

subcommands.name: delete-code-security-scan-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes a code security scan configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-connector
subcommands.description: Deletes a connector from your account.

subcommands.name: delete-filter
subcommands.description: Deletes a filter resource.

subcommands.name: describe-organization-configuration
subcommands.description: Describe Amazon Inspector configuration settings for an Amazon Web Services organization.

subcommands.name: disable
subcommands.description: Disables Amazon Inspector scans for one or more Amazon Web Services accounts.

subcommands.name: disable-delegated-admin-account
subcommands.description: Disables the Amazon Inspector delegated administrator for your organization.

subcommands.name: disassociate-member
subcommands.description: Disassociates a member account from an Amazon Inspector delegated administrator.

subcommands.name: enable
subcommands.description: Enables Amazon Inspector scans for one or more Amazon Web Services accounts.

subcommands.name: enable-delegated-admin-account
subcommands.description: Enables the Amazon Inspector delegated administrator for your Organizations organization.

subcommands.name: get-cis-scan-report
subcommands.description: Retrieves a CIS scan report.

subcommands.name: get-cis-scan-result-details
subcommands.description: Retrieves CIS scan result details.

subcommands.name: get-clusters-for-image
subcommands.description: Returns a list of clusters and metadata associated with an image.

subcommands.name: get-code-security-integration
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a code security integration.

subcommands.name: get-code-security-scan
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a specific code security scan.

subcommands.name: get-code-security-scan-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a code security scan configuration.

subcommands.name: get-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves setting configurations for Amazon Inspector scans.

subcommands.name: get-delegated-admin-account
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the Amazon Inspector delegated administrator for your organization.

subcommands.name: get-ec2-deep-inspection-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the activation status of Amazon Inspector deep inspection and custom paths associated with your account.

subcommands.name: get-encryption-key
subcommands.description: Gets an encryption key.

subcommands.name: get-findings-report-status
subcommands.description: Gets the status of a findings report.

subcommands.name: get-member
subcommands.description: Gets member information for your organization.

subcommands.name: get-sbom-export
subcommands.description: Gets details of a software bill of materials (SBOM) report.

subcommands.name: list-account-permissions
subcommands.description: Lists the permissions an account has to configure Amazon Inspector.

subcommands.name: list-cis-scan-configurations
subcommands.description: Lists CIS scan configurations.

subcommands.name: list-cis-scan-results-aggregated-by-checks
subcommands.description: Lists scan results aggregated by checks.

subcommands.name: list-cis-scan-results-aggregated-by-target-resource
subcommands.description: Lists scan results aggregated by a target resource.

subcommands.name: list-cis-scans
subcommands.description: Returns a CIS scan list.

subcommands.name: list-code-security-integrations
subcommands.description: Lists all code security integrations in your account.

subcommands.name: list-code-security-scan-configuration-associations
subcommands.description: Lists the associations between code repositories and Amazon Inspector code security scan configurations.

subcommands.name: list-code-security-scan-configurations
subcommands.description: Lists all code security scan configurations in your account.

subcommands.name: list-connector-scan-configurations
subcommands.description: Lists scan configurations for Amazon Web Services Config connectors.

subcommands.name: list-connectors
subcommands.description: Lists connectors in your account.

subcommands.name: list-coverage
subcommands.description: Lists coverage details for your environment.

subcommands.name: list-coverage-statistics
subcommands.description: Lists Amazon Inspector coverage statistics for your environment.

subcommands.name: list-delegated-admin-accounts
subcommands.description: Lists information about the Amazon Inspector delegated administrator of your organization.

subcommands.name: list-filters
subcommands.description: Lists the filters associated with your account.

subcommands.name: list-finding-aggregations
subcommands.description: Lists aggregated finding data for your environment based on specific criteria.

subcommands.name: list-findings
subcommands.description: Lists findings for your environment.

subcommands.name: list-members
subcommands.description: List members associated with the Amazon Inspector delegated administrator for your organization.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags attached to a given resource.

subcommands.name: list-usage-totals
subcommands.description: Lists the Amazon Inspector usage totals over the last 30 days.

subcommands.name: reset-encryption-key
subcommands.description: Resets an encryption key.

subcommands.name: search-vulnerabilities
subcommands.description: Lists Amazon Inspector coverage details for a specific vulnerability.

subcommands.name: send-cis-session-health
subcommands.description: Sends a CIS session health.

subcommands.name: send-cis-session-telemetry
subcommands.description: Sends a CIS session telemetry.

subcommands.name: start-cis-session
subcommands.description: Starts a CIS session.

subcommands.name: start-code-security-scan
subcommands.description: Initiates a code security scan on a specified repository.

subcommands.name: stop-cis-session
subcommands.description: Stops a CIS session.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds tags to a resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-cis-scan-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates a CIS scan configuration.

subcommands.name: update-code-security-integration
subcommands.description: Updates an existing code security integration.

subcommands.name: update-code-security-scan-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates an existing code security scan configuration.

subcommands.name: update-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the scan configuration for your Amazon Inspector account.

subcommands.name: update-connector
subcommands.description: Updates the description or provider-specific configuration details of an existing connector.

subcommands.name: update-connector-scan-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates scan configuration settings for resources associated with an Amazon Web Services Config connector.

subcommands.name: update-ec2-deep-inspection-configuration
subcommands.description: Activates, deactivates Amazon Inspector deep inspection, or updates custom paths for your account.

subcommands.name: update-encryption-key
subcommands.description: Updates an encryption key.

subcommands.name: update-filter
subcommands.description: Specifies the action that is to be applied to the findings that match the filter.

subcommands.name: update-org-ec2-deep-inspection-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the Amazon Inspector deep inspection custom paths for your organization.

subcommands.name: update-organization-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the configurations for your Amazon Inspector organization.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: connector-connected
subcommands.description: Wait until a connector reaches the CONNECTED health status, typically after CreateConnector or UpdateConnector + ConnectorEnabled.

subcommands.name: connector-deleted
subcommands.description: Wait until a connector is no longer returned by ListConnectors.

subcommands.name: connector-enabled
subcommands.description: Wait until a connector reaches the ENABLED state, whether after CreateConnector or UpdateConnector.
